description: Source code for SparkALS, an example implementation of Alternating Least Squares matrix factorization using Apache Spark, including functions for generating matrices, computing RMSE, updating vectors, and running iterative optimization.

classes.name: SparkALS
classes.description: Object implementing ALS matrix factorization with methods for matrix generation, RMSE calculation, vector updates, and main execution logic.

methods.name: generateR
methods.description: Generates a real matrix R as the product of two random matrices.

methods.name: rmse
methods.description: Calculates the root mean square error between the target matrix and the estimated ratings.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the feature vector for a given item based on user ratings.

methods.name: showWarning
methods.description: Displays a warning that this is a naive implementation of ALS.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for running the ALS example, parsing arguments, initializing Spark, and performing iterative updates.

methods.name: randomVector
methods.description: Creates a random vector of specified size.

methods.name: randomMatrix
methods.description: Creates a random matrix with specified dimensions.
